impostazioniSottotitolo: Full school configuration: modules, teaching, services and communication.
multiSedeSottotitolo: Add, rename or deactivate locations. Restricted to Management.
sidiSottotitolo: Import new enrolments, Phase A alignment, attendee submission and Piattaforma Unica. Actual transmission depends on ministerial accreditation.
spFiscaleDesc: These are the issuer’s details (cedente): they appear on the electronic invoice, on numbered receipts and on certificates (Bonus Nido/730). The registered office goes in separate fields — with an empty postal code or town the SDI rejects the invoice.
spFiscalePrecompilato: Fields prefilled with the cooperative’s details: check them and press Save. Until you save, nothing is configured.
spFiscaleErrPiva: The VAT number is 11 digits and its check digit must add up.
spFiscaleErrTroppoLungo: At most {max, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}: the invoice format cuts the rest.
spFiscaleErrCf: The tax code is 11 digits (entity) or 16 characters (individual).
spFiscaleErrProvincia: The province is a 2-letter code (e.g. CE).
spFiscaleErrRegime: The tax regime must be one of RF01, RF02, RF04…RF20 (there is no RF03).
spFiscaleErrEmail: Enter a valid email address (or leave the field empty): it goes on the invoice, in the issuer’s contact details.
spFiscaleCorreggi: Fix the highlighted fields: as it stands, the SDI would reject the invoice.
spBolloAttiva: Apply the €2 stamp duty on VAT-exempt invoices above €77.47
spBolloHint: Kept off until the accountant confirms: turning it on changes the amounts of every invoice issued from now on.
spGiornoScadenza: Fee due day — default for everyone (1-28)
spGiornoScadenzaHint: Customisable per pupil from the profile (Financial details).
spRettaVisibilitaHint: The monthly fee appears to the parent from the given day of the month before it is due.
spCausaleFatturaSpostata: The invoice description is now set per payment type:
spArubaDesc: Credentials and environment for the Aruba channel. The password is never stored in clear text: only the vault/env reference is kept.
spArubaAmbienteHint: In Demo the invoices never reach the SDI.
spArubaRimandoDatiFiscali: VAT number, tax code, company name and registered office are set in «Tax details & stamp duty» above: they are the same details that end up in the invoice’s CedentePrestatore.
rtScontoFratelliHint: The 1st child of the family pays the full fee. From the 2nd onwards, the highest tier ≤ their own position applies. Siblings are children who share a parent.
rtNessunoScaglione: No tiers: add at least one.
rtProRataHint: Applies ONLY to the enrolment month’s fee (never to absences). The amount due is the tier with the highest day ≤ the enrolment day (100% = full fee).
rtAnteprimaHint: The child’s actual position in the family is computed when fees are generated (by date of birth).
meMenuDesc: Create multiple menus for different school levels (e.g. Nursery, Preschool and Primary). Each menu has its own separate rotation plan.
meConfermaEliminaMenu: Delete this menu? The links to classes will be removed too.
meAssegnazioneDesc: Specify from which date a class switches to a given menu. The most recent rule (active from ≤ today) is the one in force.
scPivaCf: VAT / tax code of the entity
stAzioneRiservataRuolo: Restricted to Management, or you cannot change your own role.
stConfermaRigenera: Regenerate the credentials for {nome}? The previous password will no longer be valid.
stRigeneraOkPdf: Done: email sent and PDF available in the notification centre.
siImportCompletato: Import complete: {matched} matched on application number, {creati} created, {aggiornati} updated.
siGatedDefault: SIDI transmission unavailable: accreditation in progress.
siImportDesc: Upload the ministerial .zip file without renaming it. Matching is done on the Application number (tax code fallback); parents are synced by tax code.
ieImportaDesc: Download the template, fill it in (pupil + parents) and upload it back.
ieRigheErrori: {count, plural, one {# row with errors} other {# rows with errors}} (rows: {righe})
ieComeFunzionaDesc: the template has a column for each pupil detail and up to two parents. On import the system creates pupils and linked parents, avoiding duplicates via the tax code. The location is the active one.
arNotificaGenitore: Notify the parent when stock is low
arHint: Extra categories add to the standard locker material ones.
avHint: Publishing roles are applied automatically when the notice is created.
chBroadcastSoloAdmin: Broadcast messages restricted to the office
chHint: Out of hours, messages can still be sent: the parent sees the banner with the configured message.
diDesc: Configuration of the daily log. The Mood routine is already applied to the teacher’s log; the other rules will be applied in future versions.
diRitardoHint: The parent sees a log entry only after these minutes from writing (correction window for the teacher), as for primary assessments.
diEsponiPrimaria: Show the 0-6 log to primary teachers
diEsponiPrimariaHint: If disabled, teachers with only primary sections don’t see the 0-6 log (with nap/bathroom/meals): they use the Register. Off by default.
diHint: The log stays visible for the levels enabled in Features & modules.
fmDesc: Which modules are active for each school level. Disabled features don’t appear to teachers and parents and their APIs are blocked.
fmHint: Changes apply to all school users; effective immediately on refresh.
gaConsensoPrivacy: Show only media of pupils with privacy consent
gaHint: Gallery visibility by level is managed in Features & modules.
moChiInvia: Who can send forms to families
moHint: The form builder and rankings stay in the Forms section of the admin area.
noVisibileSubito: Note visible to the parent right after creation
noNotificaAdmin: Notify the office on every new note
noHint: If OTP signing is off, the parent acknowledges with a simple confirmation.
ntSicurezzaAvviso: Warning: this is a security notification; disabling it is not recommended.
ntHint: Disabled notifications aren’t created: no bell and no push, for any recipient. Notifications already queued aren’t removed.
prGiustificaFirmaOtp: The absence note requires the parent’s OTP signature
prUsciteDelega: Early pick-ups require a registered proxy
prHint: The retroactive window and OTP signing are applied automatically when absence notes are created.
meErrMenu: The menu operation failed. Try again.
